x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Opener Tool - quickly open links, paths, stored data, and REST shortcuts.

commands.name: config
commands.description: Manage storage, encryption, and global URL template settings.

commands.name: set-location
commands.description: Set a custom encrypted data-file path.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Full path to opener.dat, including the file name (e.g., C:\Users\me\Documents\opener.dat).

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show current storage path, encryption mode, global URL aliases, and global default params.

options.name: --return
options.description: Return the resolved value to stdout instead of copying/opening

options.name: --copy
options.description: Force copy the resolved value to clipboard instead of performing the default action

options.name: --search
options.description: Treat the provided key as a search term and lookup by substring (key + description)
